tried for about an hour to play this with a friend and after continually getting error n-14 decided to refund it
if this is because of an undisclosed requirement for an epic games account then honestly good riddance
if it is some other issue I'd recommend fixing it since you can find comments about it essentially going back to the game's launch
After picking this game up I got back into playing Warhammer 40k games and the lore. Not the most lore accurate game, but still a great game. [spoiler] Would have loved necrons. [/spoiler]

An excellent addition to the coop shooter genre which offers a variety of options and classes which are true to the setting.  The campaign offers a great sequel to the original story of Titus, with interesting customization options and mission-specific mechanics.

If you want to grind out your classes to Prestige IV level 25, you better have actual friends to play with  who are decent at the game. Because if you're just learning the game, it's a nightmare to grind it solo.

The bots from Left 4 Dead, a game released more than a decade before this one, are way better at helping you when you play solo. I like how this game pretends the last 15 years of companion/NPC AI development just didn't happen. I would have had a much better time if the bots weren't so damn useless.

EDIT: 375 hours in, and I have long since gotten good at the game. I am not a god at it, and probably never will be (I can solo Absolute Operations w/ bots, but not True Solo), but I can confidently say that I STILL do not recommend this game to the average person who wants to kick their feet up and play after a day of work. It's got a massive learning curve due to the variety of weapons, classes, strategies, enemies, etc. You kind of already have to be good at general game environment awareness, keen at positioning and resource management, and have good reaction times, as well as be able to focus properly during the massively cluttered screens full of enemies you'll often get in this game, all of which you need to keep track of. 

You have to force yourself to get good and learn quickly to enjoy the game, otherwise, don't bother.
